name: Kurihara Asami
source:
She is a second-year student in the violin department of Shukusei Music Academy. Her father is the director of a large municipal hospital.
She is assertive and has a manly tone of voice. She calls Shuusaku "old man." Perhaps because she has a big sister personality, she teases Chiaki but is also concerned about her.
She has outstanding proportions among the dorm residents and has a model-like figure.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/19980701104740/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/special/syusaku/syusaku11.htm]the game's website, archived[/url]]
